name: Crowley Puerto Cortes Container Terminal - Honduras

fieldNotes.yardSpots: trailerParkingCapacity (~1,100) is a CONTAINER / CHASSIS GROUND-SLOT estimate, not OTR trailer stalls. Counted from z18 satellite over the container storage yard NE of the berths: hundreds of containers in organized rows across a large unpaved/gravel depot. Marine terminal: OTR dock doors near-zero; dockDoorCount reflects the attached warehouse component only. LOW confidence - the precise Crowley-controlled footprint inside the shared Puerto Cortes terminal could not be isolated from imagery alone.
fieldNotes.attachedWarehouse: Crowley publishes a +97,000 sqft warehouse footprint for Puerto Cortes (three Choloma-area warehouses ~113k sqft combined serving the port). The warehouse buildings are not co-located on the audited container yard; dockDoorCount (~6, 0-10 band, low confidence) is a conservative placeholder for the warehouse loading doors, which sit off-terminal in the Choloma free zone, not on the quay.
fieldNotes.siteIdentification: Puerto Cortes is Honduras' principal Caribbean port. Crowley operates as a liner/terminal partner at the public container terminal (TEC, gantry-crane berths) with a landward container storage depot. z16-z18 satellite confirms: orange/yellow ship-to-shore gantry cranes at the berth with a container vessel alongside (15.838,-87.943), and a large multi-row container storage yard to the NE (15.840,-87.939). The Crowley terminal address (Barrio La Roca, frente a gasolinera DIPSA, antes del peaje) is the landward access corridor. The audited polygon covers the container yard + berth Crowley uses; exact lease boundaries within the shared port are uncertain.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Inferred secured port gate (toll/peaje + DIPSA gas station landmark on the access road per Crowley address). Specific gate hardware not resolved - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred (national secured port). Not positively resolved - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: Weighbridge standard at a container terminal - inferred true, not visually confirmed.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band: the container storage depot holds many hundreds of ground slots.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the terminal resolved. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Puerto Cortes is a coastal port town; broader setting is small-city/edge-of-town industrial -> Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.streetView: No Street View coverage within 400m of the terminal (ZERO_RESULTS) - hasCoverage=false for all zones. International port with no Google car or photosphere coverage at the gate.
fieldNotes.imageryQuality: Several wide probes around the published city coordinates fell over open water (the city centroid sits inland of the berths); the terminal was located by walking the probe NE to the gantry-crane berth. Resolution adequate at z18 but the shared-terminal layout limits confidence to LOW.
